oracle_rule.unknown_rule: preserve stale, unknown, malformed, and wrong-identity state; escalate without treating it as zero or green
oracle_rule.policy_rule: measurement only; no method winner, release verdict, or routing policy is emitted

candidate_catalog.description: Map changed path prefixes to local validation nodes.
Use a declared dependency signal when its freshness is current.
Use owner-declared nodes only with an identity-matched receipt.
Use an explicit bounded historical signal when available.
Use declared claim/risk labels as candidate activation hints.
Combine bounded signals and escalate unresolved cases to full owner proof.

candidate_catalog.reason: No stable API/ABI activation manifest is owned by this fixture.
Coverage data is not admitted as a routing oracle in this seeded slice.
No mutation-injection campaign is present; latent defect sensitivity remains unmeasured.
Live KAG relation freshness and exact owner binding are not available in this fixture.
No LLM proposal set is admitted; speculative additions must not become routing evidence.

metrics.misses: required oracle nodes absent from a candidate activation proposal, split by real versus seeded evidence
metrics.excess_nodes: activated nodes outside the scenario oracle required-node set
metrics.precision: true positives divided by activated nodes only when the oracle denominator is complete and non-empty
metrics.recall: true positives divided by required oracle nodes only when the oracle denominator is complete and non-empty
metrics.first_failure_latency_ms: cumulative candidate-route latency through the first stale, unknown, malformed, wrong-identity, or blocked event
metrics.total_latency_ms: sum of observed fixture event latencies; fallback and unexecuted external routes stay null/unmeasured
metrics.retry_amplification: attempt count divided by unique attempted targets; null when no target was attempted
metrics.stale_unknown_behavior: whether unresolved state was preserved, rejected, or escalated
metrics.explanation: candidate rationale plus missing-node explanation where available
metrics.fail_closed_escalation: explicit escalation object naming full_owner_proof fallback and its bounded status

coverage_limits: All current cases are seeded public-safe fixtures; no real-session case is copied into the fixture.
The validation-shadow report is a bounded prior and input reference, not a verdict or routing policy.
External KAG, canonical aoa-stats, and advisory trust-plane execution receipts remain absent or blocked.
No mutation injection, old-commit checkout, population estimate, causal claim, or universal false-negative rate is supported.
Unsupported candidate families remain explicit missing candidates until owner-bound evidence and a fair implementation exist.
